title: Compact Feishu CardKit daily market brief
objective: Replace the verbose Markdown delivery with a compact native Feishu interactive CardKit brief while retaining full provenance in PostgreSQL, and improve display semantics for DEX-unique trading addresses and compact USD values.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized delivery to 投研分析 and explicitly requested native Feishu CardKit delivery. The bot target may be resolved in memory only; no chat ID, credential, DATABASE_URL, raw payload, or secret may be printed or committed. First CardKit send remains gated on independent audit GREEN.
deliverables: A compact renderer without inline query provenance, a native Feishu interactive CardKit payload builder, a publisher using argument-array lark-cli invocation, in-memory bot chat resolution, default dry-run behavior, and focused tests.
forbidden_actions: Do not send a CardKit brief before independent audit GREEN.
Do not execute Dune, PostgreSQL, Hermes, or lark-cli in tests.
Do not print, persist, or commit chat IDs, Dune keys, Lark tokens, DATABASE_URL, target lookup responses, or raw provider payloads.

Do not add unverified micro metrics, scores, trading recommendations, execution, BSC/Robinhood CA/RPC adapters, backfills, B3, R2, hourly profiles, Four.meme, stablecoin, bridge, TVL, FDV/market-cap, or cohorts.
